# Academic Heights World School (AHWS)
> Premier CBSE-Affiliated Senior Secondary School (Nursery to Class XII) | Pitampura, North West Delhi

Academic Heights World School (AHWS) is a leading educational institution in Pitampura, New Delhi, operating under the renowned nationwide network of Bachpan Play Schools and Academic Heights (120+ schools across India), with higher-education continuity through Rishihood University. AHWS delivers experiential, concept-first, and competency-based education strictly aligned with the National Education Policy (NEP 2020).

## Institutional Profile
- **Full Legal Name:** Academic Heights World School
- **Affiliation:** Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE), Affiliation Code: 2730105
- **Educational Level:** Playgroup / Nursery through Class XII (Senior Secondary: Science, Commerce, Humanities)
- **Campus Address:** SD - QD Block, Near Delhi Doordarshan TV Tower, Opposite Metro Pillar No: 319, Pitampura, Delhi 110034, India
- **Geo Coordinates:** Latitude 28.694542, Longitude 77.146475
- **Contact Phone:** +91-8860455000 / 011-49402170
- **Official Email:** info@ahws.edu.in
- **Website:** https://ahws.edu.in/
- **Live Interactive Demo:** https://ayushahws-stack.github.io/ahws_WEBSITE-/

## Signature Pedagogical Differentiators
1. **SPROUT Curriculum (NEP 2020 Aligned):** A proprietary 7-layer learning framework structuring education across Foundational (Nursery-Class 2), Preparatory (Classes 3-5), Middle (Classes 6-8), and Secondary (Classes 9-12) stages. Emphasizes Multiple Intelligences, inquiry-based STEM, and hands-on discovery.
2. **AI & Robotics Innovation Lab:** Dedicated laboratory equipped with microcontrollers, sensor kits, and coding workstations where students build practical engineering projects starting in primary grades.
3. **Smart Technology Ecosystem:** Interactive Smart Classrooms with 3D learning modules, X-Wall interactive physical gaming systems, and Speak-O-Pen smart phonetics/pronunciation pens.
4. **Comprehensive 9-Sport Portfolio:** State-of-the-art sports facilities including Pickleball courts, outdoor Basketball arena, Cricket practice nets, Football field, Volleyball, Badminton, Tennis, Taekwondo, and competitive Chess.
5. **In-House Counselling & Parental Coaching:** Guided by Dr. Rashmi Bajaj Singh (28+ years experience), providing individual student guidance, emotional resilience building, POCSO child protection support, and regular parent coaching workshops.
6. **Decode Startup (Student Entrepreneurship):** A school-level startup accelerator where students formulate business plans, develop prototypes, and pitch real ideas to investors for initial seed support.
7. **360° Mobile App & School Automation:** All-in-one parent-student portal for real-time attendance, digital report cards, teacher communication, and fee payment.
8. **Holistic Campus Safety:** 150+ CCTV surveillance cameras, guarded access control, dedicated infirmary with first-aid care, and active CBSE-mandated POCSO, POSH, Anti-Bullying, and Tobacco Control committees.
